name: Globed Mobile Voice Chat
description: this mod adds a talk button for globed voice chat on android, but it requires a patch of globed with mobile voice sending enabled, which is on my github pluffyrain

enabled.name: Enable Button
enabled.description: shows the talk button IF connected to globed, turn it off to hide it completely

toggle-mode.name: Toggle Mode
toggle-mode.description: When on you instead of holding you tap once to start talking and tap again to stop, when its off you hold the button down to talk

edit-position.name: Move Button
edit-position.description: While on, drag the talk button anywhere in your screen, turn it back off to lock it in place and use it normally

button-opacity.name: Button Opacity
button-opacity.description: hoe transparent the talk button is.

button-scale.name: Button Size
button-scale.description: How fatty the talk button is

button-preview.name: Preview
button-preview.description: Live preview of the button's current size and opacity.
